name: transcosmos inc.
summary: transcosmos inc. provides business outsourcing services in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Single Service, Domestic Affiliates, and Overseas Affiliates. The company offers business processing outsourcing services, such as selling, SCM, finance, and documentation; accounting, procurement, and human resources; construction support housing and housing equipment design; machine design, built-in development, and back-office for design and production; support desk, system operation and maintenance, IoT, and multi-device lifecycle; and offshore services.
